Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap: you want us to validate inference performance at 5–10 QPS on your 8k sequences, confirm memory/KV cache behavior with your sampling strategy, and show options for batching + quantization that keep latency under 350ms P50.

Proposed next step: a single 75-minute runthrough with our ML infra + ops engineers to walk through:
- short architecture review (10m)
- live run on a subset of your model & sample payloads (35m)
- perf tuning / batching knobs + quantization demo (20m)
- mutual action plan and integration next steps (10m)

Can you share:
- 2–3 preferred 75-min windows over the next 2 weeks (include timezone)
- any blackout windows for your engineering leads (we want to avoid conflicting sprints / all-hands)
- the roster (names + roles) who will attend from your side so we can make sure right folks join on our end

Prereads attached: redwood_tdx_prereads.md (contains what we need: a ~1k-line sample, dataset size, S3 link, and service account perms). If you prefer, we can accept a sanitized sample sent to the secure link below.

If the above looks good I’ll coordinate Ben (ops) + Grace (ML lead) to own the session and send a calendar invite once we lock a time.
